name: smarabio.is
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: www.smarabio.is scores 69 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 33 are at risk, and 28 pass. Fix first: 5 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 5 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /bio, /smarabio/contact. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 12 elements on /, /bio, /skemmtisvaedi, for example .go2835993061. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 10 elements on /, /bio, /skemmtisvaedi, for example .social-icon-link.w-inline-block[href="#"]:nth-child(1) and .social-icon-link.w-inline-block[href="#"]:nth-child(2). Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: The start page does not declare its language
fix.evidence: Screen readers pick the wrong voice and browsers offer the wrong translation.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Meta Pixel (3 requests), Google Analytics (1 request), Google Ads (1 request), and cookies _ga_GNYL1GQGP5, _ga, _gid, _gat_gtag_UA_268263721_2, _fbp.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 231 ms
1 page is kept out of search on purpose
